summary: Keep one active Los Angeles/Oakland TraPac platform; record ONE at 51% from November 2, 2023 and Macquarie/MIP VI at 49% from November 1, 2023 under joint control; add MOL and Brookfield as realized owners and exclude Jacksonville and holdco or asset components.
nonblockingDisclosureGaps: Final intermediate direct-owner percentages are not public, although aggregate ONE 51% and Macquarie 49% is confirmed.
Exact Brookfield closing and 2022 repurchase dates are not public.
survivorCondition: Count TraPac, LLC once for the Los Angeles and Oakland operating platform; keep Jacksonville/Ceres separate and suppress concessions, terminals, berths, rail, cranes, holdcos and SPVs as components.
